obvious_effects: Warm food with a Restore Cold effect: on LoreRim its soups and stews; on vanilla and Simonrim only the 'Hot ...' soups and stews
notes: Only with survival active. A running warming effect stays a redundancy filter on the spell, not a need (ContextRuleEngine.h:218-223). Two mechanics, confirmed via LoreRim Discord (the user, 2026-10-09): the cold meter is restored by warming soups (warm food), and by campfires, which are not items (not an answer); warming spells (Warming Aura) and warm apparel raise the warmth rating instead (warmth_deficit), so they are not answers here. Warming soups do both: their Restore Cold (Update.esm 01002EE5) restores the cold meter (cold), their Fortify Warmth (01002EE6, Variable09) raises the warmth rating (warmth_deficit). Which soups warm depends on the load order: on LoreRim its soups and stews; on vanilla and Simonrim only the 'Hot ...' ones (ItemClassifier.cpp:631-632; docs/reference/classifier-coverage.md, Food on simonrim). LoreRim Elsweyr Fondue and the vanilla and Simonrim Hot Crab Stew carry both; on Simonrim the Fortify Warmth effect is named MAG_FoodFortifyWarmthEffect (tests/core/fixtures/effects_*.csv). Resist Frost is not an answer either (removed 0.23.17): it lowers frost damage only. Effect columns: Restore Cold (AV Mood; LoreRim keyword CCSM_RestoreCold) and Fortify Warmth both map to survival_warmth, which also holds warming spells and the Torch, so the pair cold x survival_warmth also reaches warming spells until that column is split (roadmap 'Needs and effects to add').
